LanguageData.LP_DS_CureWounds.label: divine magic: cure wounds
LanguageData.LP_DS_CureWounds.description: Instantly heal one target (can be yourself) for a total of 20 × innate power injury, worst bleeding wounds first. Mana 1, cooldown 30 seconds. Divine Soul, sorcerer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DS_Favored.label: favored by the gods
LanguageData.LP_DS_Favored.description: For 1 hour surgery success +20%, tend quality +20%. No mana cost, once per day. Divine Soul, sorcerer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DS_Resonance.label: divine resonance
LanguageData.LP_DS_Resonance.description: Passive: while meditating or praying, regain an extra 0.2 sorcerer mana every 250 ticks (25% more for believers of a god); for each point of mana spent healing others, you also recover 25% of that healing. Divine Soul, sorcerer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_DS_AngelForm.label: angelic form
LanguageData.LP_DS_AngelForm.description: Become an angel for 1 hour: teammates within 3 cells heal 2 × innate power injury every 10 seconds, and your movement +20%. Mana 3, cooldown 1 hour. Divine Soul, sorcerer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_DS_Miracle.label: miracle
LanguageData.LP_DS_Miracle.description: Active: all colonists on this map heal 50% of wounds, disease progress -30%, mood +10 (3 days). Once per quarter (cooldown 15 days), no mana cost. Passive: the first time each day you'd be downed or killed, automatically heal half your wounds and stand back up. Divine Soul, sorcerer level 15.
LanguageData.LP_SM_EyesDark.label: eyes of the dark: strength of the grave
LanguageData.LP_SM_EyesDark.description: Passive: darkness doesn't reduce work speed or aiming; while standing in darkness, sorcerer spell power +20%; when taking damage that would down or kill you, 50% chance to hold on and stay up (checked once per day; doesn't work against fire and holy damage). Shadow Magic, sorcerer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SM_Hound.label: hound of ill omen
LanguageData.LP_SM_Hound.description: Summon a hound of ill omen (1 hour) that hunts down the chosen enemy: the target can't turn invisible, and bites have a 30% chance to make it flee in fear for 5 seconds. Mana 2, cooldown 1 hour. Shadow Magic, sorcerer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_SM_ShadowStep.label: shadow step
LanguageData.LP_SM_ShadowStep.description: While standing in darkness, teleport to another dark spot within 20 cells; the next sorcerer spell afterwards gets +20% power. No mana cost, cooldown 30 seconds. Shadow Magic, sorcerer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_SM_ShadowForm.label: umbral form
LanguageData.LP_SM_ShadowForm.description: Active: for 1 hour, damage taken halved except fire, holy and force; while standing in darkness, enemy ranged attacks miss 30% of the time. Mana 3, cooldown 2 hours. Passive: mana recovery ×2 when sleeping between 22 and 6. Shadow Magic, sorcerer level 15.
LanguageData.LP_CW_Balance.label: restore balance: mechanical affinity
LanguageData.LP_CW_Balance.description: Passive: twice per day, when a friendly person on the same map fails a save, it's automatically re-rolled once. Mechanical affinity: building and mechanoid repair speed +30% (construction speed ×1.3), damage taken from mechanoids -10%. Clockwork Soul, sorcerer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_CW_Ward.label: bastion of law
LanguageData.LP_CW_Ward.description: One teammate within 15 cells gets a shield absorbing 10 + sorcerer level × 2 damage (1 hour); if they're a mechanitor, control bandwidth +2. Mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. Clockwork Soul, sorcerer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_CW_Domain.label: clockwork cavalcade
LanguageData.LP_CW_Domain.description: For 1 hour melee hit +30% and better shooting accuracy; when deployed, enemy mechanoids within 10 cells have a 30% chance to shut down for 3 seconds. Mana 3, cooldown 2 hours. Clockwork Soul, sorcerer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_CW_Legion.label: legion of order
LanguageData.LP_CW_Legion.description: Active: summon 3 order constructs (vanilla mechanoids made into friendly temporary units) to fight alongside you for 1 day, dissipating when time is up. No mana cost, cooldown 3 days. Passive: wild magic triggered by wild surge never has bad results (spontaneous combustion, entropy surge and chaotic spirits are re-rolled instead). Clockwork Soul, sorcerer level 15.
